Perseids meteor shower and summer starry sky observation event. Held at Nora Naguri, a glamping facility.

With guidance from a Star Sommelier®, you'll observe shooting stars, the Summer Triangle, the Milky Way, and more using binoculars and telescopes.

Date & Time: August 12, 2026 (Reiwa 8), 7:00 PM–8:30 PM
• Reception: 6:30 PM–
• Assembly: 6:50 PM
• Rain date: August 13 (Thursday)

Location: Nora Naguri, 607-1 Shita-Naguri, Hanno, Saitama

Fee:
• Adults: ¥1,000
• Elementary school children and under: ¥500
• Preschoolers: Free

Capacity: First come, first served; max 20 people. Advance registration required.

What to bring: Drinks, leisure sheet or folding chair.

Weather: If the event is postponed or cancelled due to poor weather, you will be notified by email by 3:00 PM on the day of the event.

For more information, visit Okumushi Hanno Tourism Association (奥むさし飯能観光協会): https://hanno-tourism.jp/
